job.title: Payroll Officer - Brisbane
job.description:
About RWM

Regional Workforce Management (RWM) is proudly Australian-owned, dedicated to connecting businesses with tailored recruitment and workforce management solutions since 2000. Formerly FIP Group, we’ve spent over two decades supporting the backbone of Australia - the food, agriculture, forestry and fisheries industries. By blending local expertise with a national reach, we deliver reliable and committed people who help businesses grow, thrive and stand strong.
  
What started as a small operation helping local businesses quickly grew into something much bigger. Our founders’ ability to connect with people, sharing experiences, solutions and hope. Helped forge strong bonds with businesses and communities alike. As we expanded from labour hire to permanent recruitment and into connecting skilled workers from across the borders, our mission has remained the same: to provide real solutions that save Australia’s food and agriculture business time and resources.

About the Role

We are seeking a Payroll Officer to join our Brisbane team; someone who enjoys working with numbers, genuinely cares about accuracy, and loves being part of a supportive workplace. In this role, you will take ownership of weekly and fortnightly payroll processing, ensuring a smooth and positive experience for our employees. Your day-to-day will include:
  • Processing weekly and fortnightly payroll
  • Collecting and reviewing timesheets and ensuring approvals are in place
  • Interpreting awards, the NES, and other employment conditions
  • Calculating termination payments, adjustments, and leave accruals
  • Responding to payroll queries and maintaining compliance
  • Managing payroll transactions across manual and automated systems
  • Processing invoices based on payroll data
About you

To be successful in this role you will be a strong communicator with the ability to build relationships across the business at all levels. You will be career focused with the drive to take on further opportunities and challenges as they rise. 
  
You will also have:
  • Preferably have 1+ years experience as a payroll officer
  • Ability to understand and interpret awards
  • An aptitude for working with bulk data
  • Accuracy and a keen eye for detail which your referees will attest to
  • Ability to work efficiently either in a team environment or individually 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • High competence with Microsoft Office 
If you believe you have what it takes to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you! Click ‘APPLY NOW’.
